svg.aria-label: What Trawl can read, by family and format. Read by content: photos, screenshots, video, audio, voice notes and documents, including spreadsheets, slides and e-books. Every format is attempted. Fails safely: a format this phone can't open is marked failed and stays findable by name. Skipped: clutter only. Damaged or fake files are noted without a crash.

g.text: 241 test files on 3 real phones, 0 crashes.
Read by content search finds it by what is in it
Name only found by its name; not opened yet
Fails safely this phone can't open it: marked failed, name still found
Skipped clutter only: cache, thumbnails, trash, temp, empty
Damaged or fake noted, then Trawl moves on
* some variants differ by phone or codec, or were fixed after the sweep.
